nodes.summary: Let $L$ be a list of pairs of natural numbers in which every pair $(k, j)$ has size $k \ge 1$, and let $n$ be a natural number. A multiset $s$ of pairs belongs to the set of multisets drawn from $L$ with size sum $n$ if and only if every element of $s$ lies in $L$ and the sizes of the elements of $s$, counted with multiplicity, sum to $n$.
